# P38.3b — Round-11 spec reconciliation (row 506)

The canonical design specification (`docs/2_canonical_design_spec.md`, **994 requirement
ids**) re-read against what the Round-11 chain actually landed. Reconcile-build `spec`
mode in its proposals-only posture (`apply_amendments=false` — the skill default and the
contract's "spec-source amendment proposal" cell): every spec↔build drift is recorded as
an **accepted deviation** (the signed GATE-ACCEPT-R11 list is authoritative), a **`D-…`
deferral row**, or a **`spec_src` amendment proposal** — the spec itself is edited only
through `spec_src` + `BUILD.sh`, and this row edits no spec text at all.

Read-only: `live_verification=false`; no production mutation, no live leg, no gate
tick, no source flip, no `ingestion_permitted` change, no operator contact.

mapped to the spec record that carries it (or named where none exists — none found);
and the residual text↔landed drift becomes the proposal set of §6.
